title: Whatever You Do
question: What changes about ordinary work when it is done for the Lord?
blurb: Four verses about the daily, unglamorous work — and who it is really for.

nodes.content: What changes about ordinary work when it is done for the Lord?

nodes.verseText: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might, for in Sheol, where you are going, there is no work or planning or knowledge or wisdom.
